image_description: A large, translucent soap bubble dominates the foreground, held by a wand gripped by a person in a red top on the right. The bubble exhibits strong iridescent coloration (pinks, greens, blues) and reflects/distorts the background scene of a brick building and street. A second person is partially visible in the background.
